hints.voice: test -d source || cp -r {SKILL}/assets/template source;  (cd source && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund);  python3 {S}/voice.py --project . --emit source/timing.js
hints.visuals: Write source/scenes.js (keep source/kit/; every element keyed to line ids; see {SKILL}/references/handdrawn-guide.md), then: node {S}/capture.mjs --page source/index.html --stills lines --timing timing.json --stills-dir stills   (plus --stills <t1,t2,...> for the busiest moments). Open every still with Read, fix, re-render stills. Check text size and contrast: python3 {S}/legibility.py --project . (fix every red box in stills/legibility/, re-shoot, re-run), then: python3 {S}/vstate.py attest visuals "<what you checked and fixed>"
hints.render: node {S}/capture.mjs --page source/index.html --bench 3   then:  mkdir -p build && nohup node {S}/capture.mjs --page source/index.html --out build/silent.mp4 --workers 4 --crf 21 --max-minutes 100 > build/render.log 2>&1 &   Poll build/render.log (tail -3) until it prints 'wrote .../build/silent.mp4'. If it says 'stopped at the 100-minute budget', run the same command again (finished segments are skipped). Then python3 {S}/vstate.py advance
